login.title: Admin sign in
login.notEmail: Sign in with your full email address, for example name@example.com.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for UNZANAC Admin.
verify.invalid: That code didn't work. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try again.
verify.expired: Sign-in took too long. Please sign in again.
verify.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then sign in again.

setup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
setup.intro: Every admin account is protected by an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. You'll need it each time you sign in.
setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
setup.backupBody: Write these down and keep them somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.
setup.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Wait for a new code and try again.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.shareHelp: Copy this text and paste it into the congregation's WhatsApp groups.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: Use **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://…) and lines starting with "- " for lists.
fields.pinnedHint: Pinned announcements always show first on the home page.
fields.publishAtHint: Leave empty to publish now. A future time schedules it.
fields.expiresAtHint: Optional, e.g. the day after the event it's about.

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. Start with the regular divine service.

recurrence.monthly_date: Every month on the same date
recurrence.monthly_weekday: Every month on the same weekday (e.g. 3rd Sunday)
recurrence.monthly_last_weekday: Every month on the last weekday (e.g. last Sunday)

fields.title: Title
fields.untilHint: Optional. Leave empty to repeat until changed.
fields.mapUrlHint: Optional. Paste a Google Maps link starting with https://
fields.audienceHint: Optional, e.g. Everyone, Youth, Sunday school.
fields.isServiceHint: The next divine service is shown at the top of the home page.
fields.showInScheduleHint: For repeating events such as Sunday service or choir practice.
fields.livestreamUrlHint: Optional. While the event is running, the home page shows a "Live now" banner with this link.

dates.title: Upcoming dates
dates.intro: Cancel or move a single date without changing the rest of the series.
dates.none: No dates in the next six months.
dates.noteHint: Optional, e.g. "Joint service at Lusaka Central".
dates.newEndHint: Optional. Keeps the usual length if empty.

committees.title: Committees
committees.intro: Committees appear on the public site, in the join form and in register filters.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Optional. Made from the name if empty, e.g. first-aid. It can't be changed later.
fields.descriptionHint: What the committee does. Same formatting as announcements.
fields.phoneHint: Shown publicly with a WhatsApp link.
fields.isPublicHint: Hidden committees stay available inside the admin area.

content.title: Site content
content.intro: Text and links shown on the public site. Changes appear straight away.
content.markdownHint: Use **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://…) and lines starting with "- " for lists.

hero.title: Home page welcome
hero.intro: The large greeting at the top of the home page.
hero.heading: Heading
hero.headingHint: Keep it short: it's shown in large text.

location.title: Church location
location.intro: Used on the Church finder map, the visit page and as the default venue for new events.
location.name: Name
location.addressHint: e.g. Great East Road, opposite the UNZA main gate
location.mapUrlHint: A Google Maps link starting with https://
location.coordinatesHelp: Map position for the Church finder. In Google Maps, press and hold (or right-click) the church: the two numbers shown are the latitude and longitude.

visit.title: "Plan your visit" page
visit.intro: What a first-time visitor should know.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: Shown on the home and visit pages. Leave a row empty to remove it.
contacts.name: Name

social.title: Social links
social.intro: Shown in the footer of every page.
social.facebookHint: Use the page's permanent address, not a share link (share links can expire).

verse.title: Verse of the week
verse.intro: Optional. Leave the text empty to hide it.

privacy.title: Privacy notice

about.title: "About us" page
about.intro: Who the congregation is. Shown under About in the main menu.

media.title: Media
media.urlHint: A YouTube link (video, Short, live or playlist) or a Facebook video link.
media.importTitle: New uploads from the YouTube channel
media.importHelp: New uploads are also checked every night. They arrive as drafts for you to categorise and publish.

media.noChannel: Set the channel ID to import uploads automatically.

fields.title: Title
fields.featuredHint: Only one video is featured at a time; featuring this one replaces the current one.

resources.title: Resources
resources.intro: Files for members to download: programmes, notices, lesson sheets, practice audio.
resources.copyright: Link to official NAC material (hymnal, catechism, community magazine, broadcasts) instead of uploading it, unless permission has been given.
resources.deleteHelp: The resource disappears at once. Its files are removed after {days} days, so it can be restored until then.
resources.deletedNotice: This resource was deleted. Its files will be removed on {date}.

fields.title: Title
fields.visibilityHint: Unlisted resources don't appear in lists or search; anyone with the link can download them.

upload.label: Choose a file
upload.hint: PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel up to 25 MB; JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB; MP3 or M4A up to 50 MB. The link stays the same when you replace a file.

homePhotos.title: Home photos
homePhotos.intro: Photos for the slider at the top of the home page. They are resized for phones automatically, and location data from the camera is removed. Visitors download only the first photo unless they swipe.
homePhotos.empty: No photos yet. Without photos, the home page shows the Azure welcome band.

upload.altHint: What the photo shows, e.g. "Members of the congregation after the youth service". Read out to blind visitors.
upload.fileHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. Wide photos work best; the slider crops to a banner shape.
